title: Ningen Shikkaku: Director's Cut Ban
justification: Checked by title. The film is TMDB movie 74799 (Ningen Shikkaku: Director's Cut-ban (2009)). TMDB show 61289 does not carry it, so the node leaves that show. The node moves from TVDB 119781 to the movie marker. The 89-minute theatrical re-edit of the four No Longer Human episodes of Aoi Bungaku is not an episode of TVDB 119781 (no season 0) or of TMDB 61289 (no season 0), and TheTVDB has no movie for it under its Japanese or English titles. TMDB has it as movie 74799 (Ningen Shikkaku: Director's Cut-ban, 2009). AniDB types it a film, so the node takes the movie marker with that id.
